faq.outageQ: Do solar panels work during a power outage?
faq.outageA: It depends on the type of plant. A grid-tied plant shuts down with the grid during an outage, even in full sun. Hybrid and off-grid plants with a battery keep working: during the day the panels power the house and charge the battery, and in the evening and at night the battery takes over. {Locative} a hybrid plant with a battery is installed for this — how many hours it lasts is shown on the “Backup power {locative}” page.

hero.title:
Turnkey
backup power
hero.lead: We will choose, install and service a system that keeps the lights, boiler, fridge and internet on during outages. Built on SVIT batteries or ready-made Deye, Victron and Huawei systems.

segments.title: Backup power for an apartment, a house and a business
segments.lead: The system depends on what has to run without the grid and for how many hours. We size it for your site — from a portable station to an industrial battery.

how.title: How backup power works
how.lead: While the grid is on, the system charges the battery. When the power goes, the inverter switches the house to the battery automatically — nothing to turn on by hand.
how.solarTitle: Add solar panels — and the battery charges from the sun
how.solarText: With a hybrid inverter, a backup system can be extended to a solar plant at any time.

equipment.title: What equipment we install
equipment.lead: We do not tie you to one brand: we recommend SVIT batteries, and we equally select, sell, install and service Deye, Victron and Huawei backup systems — inverters together with batteries.
equipment.svitText: INIT ENERGY batteries — from a {min} portable station to a {max} system.

runtime.title: How long the system will last
runtime.lead: Runtime = usable battery capacity ÷ appliance power. Guide figures for typical sets with every appliance running all the time:
runtime.caption: Approximate runtime of SVIT batteries for typical appliance sets
runtime.footnote: Usable capacity is {share} of nominal (typical for LiFePO₄). Appliance power from Minfin data; the pump is {pump}. The fridge and the pump run in cycles, so the real time is usually longer. SVIT PLUS 16000 works with a hybrid inverter.

promo.title: Add solar panels to your backup power
promo.description: A hybrid system charges the battery from the sun by day and keeps the house running during outages. Design, equipment, installation and commissioning — turnkey.

compare.title: Generator, UPS or a battery system
compare.lead: A generator gives plenty of energy but is noisy and needs fuel. A regular UPS lasts minutes. A battery system runs quietly for hours and switches over by itself.
